description_en: Queries the IM channel list of a specified agent
description_zh: 查询指定智能体的 IM 渠道列表
kebab_example: aliyun agentcore list-agent-im-channels --workspace-id ws-1 --agent-id agent-1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListAgentIMChannels

parameters.help_en:
The IM channel type. Valid values:
DINGTALK: DingTalk.
FEISHU: Lark.
WECOM: WeCom
parameters.help_zh: IM 渠道类型。枚举值：DINGTALK（钉钉）、FEISHU（飞书）、WECOM（企业微信）
parameters.name: channel_type

parameters.help_en:
The IM channel status. Valid values:
CREATING: being created.
READY: ready.
UPDATING: being updated.
FAILED: failed.
DELETING: being deleted.
DELETE_FAILED: deletion failed
parameters.help_zh: IM 渠道状态。枚举值：CREATING（创建中）、READY（就绪）、UPDATING（更新中）、FAILED（失败）、DELETING（删除中）、DELETE_FAILED（删除失败）
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries to return per page. Default value: 20. Valid values: 1 to 100
parameters.help_zh: 单页最大返回条数，默认 20，取值范围为 1～100
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The pagination token. You do not need to specify this parameter for the first request. For subsequent requests, use the nextToken value returned in the previous response
parameters.help_zh: 分页令牌。首次调用可不传；后续调用使用上一次响应返回的 nextToken
parameters.name: next_token

schema.description_en: The successful response for querying the IM channel list of an agent
schema.description_zh: 查询智能体 IM 渠道列表的成功响应

code.description_en: The business status code. A value of SUCCESS indicates success
code.description_zh: 业务状态码。成功时为 SUCCESS

httpStatusCode.description_en: The HTTP status code. A value of 200 indicates success

showThinking.description_en: Specifies whether to display the thinking process in IM messages. Default value: false
showThinking.description_zh: 是否在 IM 消息中展示思考过程，默认值为 false

showToolCalls.description_en: Specifies whether to display the tool calling process in IM messages. Default value: false
showToolCalls.description_zh: 是否在 IM 消息中展示工具调用过程，默认值为 false

channelType.description_en:
The IM channel type. Valid values:
DINGTALK: DingTalk.
FEISHU: Lark.
WECOM: WeCom
channelType.description_zh: IM 渠道类型。枚举值：DINGTALK（钉钉）、FEISHU（飞书）、WECOM（企业微信）

createTime.description_en: The creation time in RFC 3339 format

credentialSummary.description_en: The channel credential summary. Only non-sensitive fields and configured secret field names are returned. Secret values are not returned
credentialSummary.description_zh: 渠道凭据摘要，仅返回非敏感字段和已配置的 Secret 字段名，不返回 Secret 值

configuredSecretFields.description_en: The list of configured secret field names. Secret values are not included
configuredSecretFields.description_zh: 已配置的 Secret 字段名列表，不包含 Secret 值

items.description_en: The name of the configured secret field
items.description_zh: 已配置的 Secret 字段名

additionalProperties.description_en: The value of the non-sensitive credential field

nonSecretFields.description_en: The non-sensitive credential fields and their values
nonSecretFields.description_zh: 非敏感凭据字段及其值

enabled.description_en: Indicates whether the IM channel is enabled. Default value upon creation: true
enabled.description_zh: 是否启用该 IM 渠道。创建时默认值为 true

endpointUrl.description_en: The public network access URL of the attached ServiceEndpoint
endpointUrl.description_zh: 绑定的 ServiceEndpoint 公网访问地址

serviceEndpointId.description_en: The ID of the bound ServiceEndpoint. The endpoint must belong to the specified agent and its current version, be in the ready state, and have a public network address
serviceEndpointId.description_zh: 绑定的 ServiceEndpoint ID。该端点必须属于指定智能体及其当前版本，并已就绪且具有公网地址

status.description_en:
The IM channel status. Valid values:
CREATING: being created.
READY: ready.
UPDATING: being updated.
FAILED: failed.
DELETING: being deleted.
DELETE_FAILED: deletion failed
status.description_zh: IM 渠道状态。枚举值：CREATING（创建中）、READY（就绪）、UPDATING（更新中）、FAILED（失败）、DELETING（删除中）、DELETE_FAILED（删除失败）

statusReason.description_en: The reason for the current status of the IM channel
statusReason.description_zh: IM 渠道当前状态的原因说明

updateTime.description_en: The update time in RFC 3339 format

maxResults.description_en: The maximum number of entries returned per page for this request
maxResults.description_zh: 本次请求的单页最大返回条数

message.description_en: The message returned for the request

nextToken.description_en: The token for the next page. An empty value indicates that the last page has been reached
nextToken.description_zh: 下一页令牌。为空表示已到末页

success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful

totalCount.description_en: The total number of records that match the query conditions
